Each branch decides where it delivers, for how much and how fast. "}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Set up a branch for delivery","key":"md_set_up_a_branch_for_delivery","id":"set-up-a-branch-for-delivery","name":"md_set_up_a_branch_for_delivery","value":"# Set up a branch for delivery In the **Restaurant** (Delivery section): - **Take delivery orders**: turns delivery on for this branch. - **Delivery orders go to**: a table that holds them, for example *Delivery* in a counter room. Create it first on the [floor plan](/Docs/Floor%20Plan). - **Guests order delivery online**: also offer delivery on the online ordering page. - **Delivery fee account**: the income account the fee is booked to. The fee is a charge on the invoice, like the tip. - **Delivery zones**, one row per zone: - **Zone**: a name (Downtown, Eastie). - **ZIP codes**: separated by commas or spaces. A trailing `*` covers a prefix: `021*` is every ZIP code that starts with 021. - **Delivery fee**, **Minimum order**, **Delivery time** (minutes). - **Active**. When two branches cover a ZIP code, the one with the exact ZIP code comes before one that covers it with a prefix."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Taking a phone order","key":"md_taking_a_phone_order","id":"taking-a-phone-order","name":"md_taking_a_phone_order","value":"# Taking a phone order On the POS, tap **Delivery** at the top. People who take orders see it when a branch they work at delivers. 1. Type the **ZIP code**. Ren POS shows the branches that deliver there, with fee, minimum and time. The first one is suggested; you can pick another one, even one whose zones don't cover the ZIP code (then it has no fee). 2. Type the **phone**: a known customer comes up with their saved addresses. Otherwise type the name to create the customer. 3. Choose or type the **address**, with **Save address** to keep it on the customer, and add **notes** (gate code, ring twice). 4. Create the order. It opens on the branch's delivery table, ready to add items. If it is another branch you work at, the POS switches to it. The order shows a banner with the address, zone, fee, delivery time and how much is still missing to reach the minimum. Charge it as usual; the fee is added to the bill."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Getting it out the door","key":"md_getting_it_out_the_door","id":"getting-it-out-the-door","name":"md_getting_it_out_the_door","value":"# Getting it out the door Use a production center that **waits for the whole order** with a status that **asks who delivers**, so the driver is recorded when the order leaves. See [Dispatch and drivers](/Docs/Dispatch)."}}]}]
